title: WebSocket-first transport list does not actually fall back to long-polling when WebSocket is blocked
test: tests/socketOptions.test.js: 'client connects over long-polling when WebSocket upgrades are blocked' (and 'client socket options prefer WebSocket and enable the long-polling fallback')
proof: Before the fix, with the options copied from src/context/SocketContext.jsx (transports ['websocket','polling'], no tryAllTransports), a socket.io server with all WebSocket upgrades dropped never connected: three 'websocket error' connect_error events, then 'never connected (connect_error x3)'. With the options module as shipped, the test passes; with tryAllTransports set to false the same test fails (both tests 'not ok').
